tagline: Independent self-regulation of the UK press
hero_kpi_rationale: The volume of complaints handled is the primary indicator of activity and impact for IPSO, reflecting its central role in regulating the British press and holding publishers accountable.

kpis.name: Number of complaints received
kpis.explanation: Total number of complaints filed by the public against regulated media.
kpis.description: IPSO receives thousands of complaints per year, reflecting its active role in press regulation.
kpis.signal: High volume of complaints each year

kpis.name: Proportion of complaints with upheld outcomes
kpis.explanation: Percentage of complaints resulting in an outcome favorable to the complainant.
kpis.description: Over the past three years, 71% of complaints resulted in a favorable outcome, primarily through agreements with publishers or favorable adjudications.
kpis.signal: 71% of complaints handled result in a favorable outcome

kpis.name: Privacy notices issued
kpis.explanation: Number of notices issued to protect individuals' privacy against media intrusion.
kpis.description: In 2020, IPSO issued 538 privacy notices during its first decade of operations, particularly during the pandemic, to indicate individuals did not wish to be approached by journalists.
kpis.signal: 538 notices issued in 2020 to protect privacy

kpis.name: Total Revenue
kpis.description: Total revenue extracted from yfinance.income_stmt over the last 4 years.
kpis.signal: Revenue of 2.52 Bn € in the latest year

kpis.name: Net Income
kpis.description: Net income extracted from yfinance.income_stmt over the last 4 years.
kpis.signal: Net income of 0.19 Bn € in the latest year

kpis.name: Total Assets

kpis.signal: Total assets of 3.08 Bn € in the latest year

ai_positioning.summary: IPSO is gradually integrating artificial intelligence into its regulatory framework by publishing positions and engaging with experts, without making it a central pillar.
evidence: IPSO hosted an AI conference in 2024
Published positions on AI in the information gathering process
Engaged in dialogue with journalists and experts on AI
Responded to challenges posed by deepfakes and AI-generated content in the editorial process
